title: Fix AX-1's EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:) grep to match multi-line dart-format output, and fix the resulting hit in track_management_body.dart
why: track_management_body.dart:102-107 uses EdgeInsets.only(left: 16, right: 16, top: 8, bottom: 96) — the exact pattern AX-1 bans. The root Makefile's check 10/12 grep is single-line only (`[^)]*` cannot span the newline dart format inserts after 4+ named args), so `grep -rn 'EdgeInsets\.only([^)]*\(left\|right\):' lib/` returns zero hits repo-wide even though this exact violation exists; a `-Pzo` multiline reproduction confirms the hit. Because left==right==16 here there's no live RTL rendering bug today, but the checker gives false confidence: a future edit that makes left != right (a real RTL mirror bug) would ship silently, and this is the only file in the batch with this shape so the blind spot is real, not hypothetical.
recommendation: Rewrite the grep to be multiline-aware (e.g. `grep -Pzo` or a small Dart/Python AST-ish scan) so it catches EdgeInsets.only(...) regardless of formatting, then replace this instance with EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start:, end:, top:, bottom:).
acceptance_criteria: The root Makefile's AX-1 check flags a deliberately-added multi-line EdgeInsets.only(left:...) fixture.
track_management_body.dart's padding is EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start:, end:, top:, bottom:).
`make audit` (root) still exits 0 after the fix.
mergedFrom: Extend the Makefile RTL audit grep to cover Alignment.centerLeft/Right and TextAlign.left/right, not just EdgeInsets.only
Replace EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:) with EdgeInsetsDirectional in track_management_hub_screen
